approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the ACME Bonsai Creative Director team (Masahiko)

approve_deliverable.notes: Every design deliverable requires Masahiko's review against brand system before delivery.

approve_photo_shoot.notes: Photo shoots require Masahiko's review of edited proofs before library archive.

approve_care_guide.notes: Care guides require Care Education technical review AND Masahiko brand review before publication.

approve_creative_project_large.notes: Creative projects > $2,000 require Jane approval before commitment.

approve_rebranding.notes: Rebranding or major identity change requires Jane approval.

approve_brand_system_update.notes: Brand system updates require Masahiko + Jane approval with impact analysis across all touchpoints.

approve_external_publish.notes: Publishing any asset to external surfaces requires Masahiko approval. Idempotency key required.

approve_photo_release_request.notes: Requesting photo release from customer requires Masahiko's review of request wording.

emergency_stop.notes: Emergency stop on asset publication can be activated immediately by Masahiko or Jane.
